### Observed differences

- In the later window, A02 appears in about 65 in 100 traces, compared with about 15 in 100 in the earlier window, and its mean event position moves from about 53 in 100 to about 20 in 100 [OCC001, POS001].
- In the later window, about 60 in 100 observed outgoing transitions from A14 go to A02, compared with about 1 in 100 in the earlier window, while A14 to A15 falls from about 84 in 100 to about 37 in 100 [DIR004].
- In the later window, about 87 in 100 observed outgoing transitions from A02 go to A15, whereas in the earlier window A02's outgoing transitions were spread over A46 (about 21 in 100), A16 (about 15 in 100), A22 (about 9 in 100) and A15 (about 9 in 100) [DIR001].
- In the later window, A02 co-occurs with A14, A15, A20, A22, A23, A25, A29, A30, A40, A45 and A46 in about 65 in 100 traces, compared with about 15 in 100 in the earlier window; with A14, A14 is before A02 in about 59 in 100 co-occurring traces; with A15, A02 is before A15 in about 33 in 100 co-occurring traces and interleaved or repeated in about 30 in 100; with A20, A22, A23, A25, A29, A30, A40, A45 and A46, A02 is before them in about 57 to 61 in 100 co-occurring traces [REL001, REL002, REL004, REL006, REL007, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014].
- In the later window, A02 also co-occurs more with A19, A21 and A24 (about 27, 18 and 21 in 100 traces, compared with about 5, 7 and 6 in 100), and is before them in about 24, 15 and 19 in 100 co-occurring traces, respectively [REL003, REL005, REL008].
- In the later window, A19 appears in about 44 in 100 traces, compared with about 32 in 100 in the earlier window, and its mean event position moves from about 69 in 100 to about 36 in 100; its dominant successor changes from A30 (about 97 in 100) to A25 (about 98 in 100) [POS002, DIR005].
- In the later window, A21 and A24 become less frequent (about 29 in 100 and about 28 in 100 traces, compared with about 39 in 100 and about 32 in 100) and earlier (mean event positions about 38 in 100 and about 37 in 100, compared with about 67 in 100 and about 68 in 100), and their dominant successors change from A30 to A25 [POS004, POS007, DIR007, DIR010].
- In the later window, A20, A22 and A23 have mean event positions of about 64 to 65 in 100, compared with about 40 in 100 in the earlier window, and their outgoing transitions lose A25 (about 30 to 38 in 100 before) and gain A30 (about 31 to 33 in 100 after) [POS003, POS005, POS006, DIR006, DIR008, DIR009].
- In the later window, A25's mean event position moves from about 46 in 100 to about 39 in 100, and A25 is before A20, A22 and A23 in about 97 to 99 in 100 co-occurring traces, whereas in the earlier window A20, A22 and A23 were before A25 in about 98 to 99 in 100 co-occurring traces [POS008, REL022, REL029, REL032].
- In the later window, A29's mean event position moves from about 65 in 100 to about 58 in 100, and its successors change from A21, A24 and A19 (about 31 to 36 in 100 each before) to A20, A22 and A23 (about 31 to 33 in 100 each after); A29 is before A20, A22 and A23 in about 97 to 98 in 100 co-occurring traces after, whereas before A20, A22 and A23 were before A29 in about 97 to 99 in 100 co-occurring traces [POS009, DIR011, REL023, REL030, REL033].
- In the later window, A40's outgoing transitions shift from A22, A20 and A23 (about 25 to 33 in 100 each before) to A19, A21 and A24 (about 27 to 40 in 100 each after) [DIR012].
- In the later window, A06 and A10 become less frequent, with trace participation falling from about 22 in 100 to about 5 in 100 for A06 and from about 17 in 100 to about 6 in 100 for A10 [OCC002, OCC003].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

- Main hypothesis: The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, A02 became a common early step after A14 and is followed by A15, while A19, A21, A24, A25 and A29 were placed earlier and before A20, A22 and A23, which moved later and routed to A30 instead of A25 [OCC001, DIR004, DIR001, POS001, REL001, REL002, LAG005, POS002, DIR005, REL015, REL016, REL017, POS004, POS007, DIR007, DIR010, REL020, REL021, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL031, REL034, REL035, POS008, REL022, REL029, REL032, POS009, DIR011, REL023, REL030, REL033, POS003, POS005, POS006, DIR006, DIR008, DIR009].
- Supporting signs: A14 to A02 and A02 to A15 are direct successor changes, with A14-A02 distance 1 rising from about 20 in 100 to about 98 in 100 and A02-A15 distance 1 rising from about 39 in 100 to about 48 in 100; A02's co-occurrence and before-relations with A15 and later activities increase; A19, A21, A24, A25 and A29 move earlier; A19, A21, A24 and A29 change successors to A25 or to A20/A22/A23; A25 and A29 become before A20/A22/A23; A20/A22/A23 move later and route to A30 [DIR004, DIR001, LAG005, LAG001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, POS002, POS004, POS007, POS008, POS009, DIR005, DIR007, DIR010, DIR011, REL022, REL029, REL032, REL023, REL030, REL033, POS003, POS005, POS006, DIR006, DIR008, DIR009].
- Other differences: A40's successors shift to A19, A21 and A24; A06 and A10 become less frequent; A43 and A45 show only small successor concentration changes [DIR012, OCC002, OCC003, DIR013, DIR014].
- The evidence is control-flow only, and positions are event positions rather than clock time [screening, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009].
- The items may reflect the same underlying reordering rather than independent changes, and a mixture of variants or sampling noise for smaller changes cannot be ruled out, although the control-flow item count is far above the chance expectation [screening, OCC001, DIR004, POS001, REL001, LAG005, OCC002, OCC003, DIR013, DIR014, LAG002, LAG007].
